2226-4443-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4443-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Riftwing Cloudskate by paying its mana cost.
When Riftwing Cloudskate enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1395-4359-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-3284-3899.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3284-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

4365-5702-7798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4365-5702-7798.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

1020-2866-5231-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1020-2866-5231-7693.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Armor Wars.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Armor Wars.
Repeat.

1357-4697-7089.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-4697-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 4.
1357-4697-7089.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

891-2034-5617.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

296-3532-4668-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
296-3532-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-2438-7213.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

413-3991-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

104-4050-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4050-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7159.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1379-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

11-121-3258-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-3258-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Beacon of Tomorrows.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Beacon of Tomorrows spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Beacon of Tomorrows spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Beacon of Tomorrows and returning the original Beacon of Tomorrows to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Beacon of Tomorrows from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

4311-5051-5078-6006.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3234-3293-3967-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3967-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3967-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

413-539-3045-3293.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
413-539-3045-3293.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Blasting Station and Emeria Shepherd trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
413-539-3045-3293.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

969-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1879-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

851-2043-5231-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Cats, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
851-2043-5231-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

2557-2933-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1692-2104-3662.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
1692-2104-3662.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chemister.
1692-2104-3662.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

674-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact creature.
674-2034-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Syr Ginger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to scry 1.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2173-2459-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2713-3099-3767-4587.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
2713-3099-3767-4587.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1467-1999-2793.notablePrerequisites:
Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
You have not copied a spell with Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-1999-2793.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying the Ugin's Nexus spell.
Resolve the copied Ugin's Nexus.
Resolve the Ugin's Nexus from step 1, exiling the token copy of Ugin's Nexus due to the legend rule and taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing not to put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
